thread:
jen: Heads-up — PR #482 needs a quick wording pass on retention examples in the SDK snippets. Legal requested clearer consent vs TTL language for audit exports.

alex: linking it — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 :eyes:

maria: quick note, the SDK examples currently show `ttl_seconds` without clarifying whether it applies to tenant-scoped or global logs. Legal wants explicit tenant scope.

jen: exact ask from legal-sam: 'Please add one short sentence that clarifies retention applies per-tenant unless otherwise noted, and include an example for private (VPC/on-prem) deployments where retention may be governed by customer policy.'

legal-sam: thanks. also please avoid the term "forever" — prefer "indefinite retention subject to legal hold" for the legal-hold edge case.

liam: I can patch the code snippets. Proposed compact example to include in the docs page:

```python
# set retention for tenant 'acme'
client.set_audit_retention(tenant_id='acme', ttl_seconds=60*60*24*90)
# This config sets a 90-day retention for tenant-scoped audit logs.
```

alex: nice. can we add a one-line note after the snippet: "Tenant retention is independent of global archival settings; private deployments may override per-customer policies."

maria: +1 but tweak: "Tenant retention applies to logs collected for that tenant; global archival or legal hold requests may extend preservation beyond the TTL."

jen: perfect. also add a short example for export redaction so customers know we do not store PII in cleartext by default:

```bash
# example export command (redacts sensitive fields)
redwood export audits --tenant acme --since 2026-01-01 --redact=ip,email
```

liam: will include the `--redact` flag note in the SDK samples too (JS + Python).

legal-sam: add this sentence for SOC-related pages: "Retention and redaction policies are configurable per-tenant; Redwood provides default redaction and supports customer-managed key enforcement for private deployments."

jen: ok action items: liam to update snippets + inline notes (PR branch), maria to add the short legal-approved sentences, alex to run linkcheck and update the example link anchor, legal-sam to approve final wording on the PR. I'll drop a quick review once updated.

docs-bot: PR #482 status changed: updates pushed by liam — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/abc123 :white_check_mark:

alex: quick QA ask — can we make the TTL example use human-friendly units in the sample (e.g., `90 days` comment) and keep machine value as seconds? small readability win.

liam: done. pushed the human-friendly comment. PR now has: 1) tenant-scoped TTL example, 2) export redaction snippet, 3) SOC-friendly one-line wording from legal.

maria: I'll post the PR link to legal for sign-off after CI finishes. Thanks everyone, looks concise enough for the docs page. :tada:

legal-sam: LGTM pending CI. If any further phrasing tweaks, keep them to one short sentence so the docs stay readable for engineers.

jen: thanks — closing loop. will merge after sign-off and linkcheck.
